label: IN-ACT_2, virtual reading: nothing is virtually in act and in POTENCY_1 in the same respect
paraphrase: IN-ACT_2, virtual reading (attribution deferred): nothing is virtually in act and in potency in the same respect. It excludes having the power to produce a perfection while being in potency to it, a stronger demand than Metaphysics IX.6 states (DISAMB-IN-ACT).
